scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently applied for a housing loan and I was wondering if you could help me with the status of my application? I applied for a conventional loan for a home purchase, and I did not request a preapproval. My loan amount was $65,000 and the term was 240 months. Could you tell me if my application has been approved, denied, or is still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and the loan has been originated.

dialogue.user: That's great news! Could you tell me what my interest rate is and the total costs of this loan? Also, are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 6.49%. The record does not include total loan costs. This loan is not a high-cost mortgage and does not have negative amortization.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Could you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? And what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has not been sold to another institution. You were approved for a conventional subordinate lien loan.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for letting me know. I think that covers everything I needed to know. <Satisfied> The agent was helpful and provided all the information I needed in a clear and polite manner.
